Lens & Light Weddings — Candid Wedding Photography, Udaipur

Lens & Light Weddings is an Udaipur-based team focused on destination and
palace-venue weddings around Lake Pichola and the surrounding Aravalli resorts.
They lean cinematic — drone-heavy films, dramatic golden-hour portraits, and
teaser edits delivered within 48 hours.

Their flagship destination package (three days, full crew) is ₹3,20,000 and
includes drone coverage, a cinematic film, and a coffee-table album.
